title: World Agricultural Markets / International Trading of Agricultural Products

skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students will understand the basic functions and characteristics of the global agricultural market, international commitments in agricultural trade under global economic integration.
Students will be able to analyze the global market trends for major agricultural products such as rice, seafood, fruits, and coffee.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Evaluating Vietnam's position in global agricultural markets
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students will assess Vietnam's role and opportunities in the global agricultural market.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Government management of international agricultural trade
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students will understand government regulations and management of international agricultural trade.
Students will develop the ability to present information on specific agricultural commodities in the global market.
Students will improve their communication skills with peers and stakeholders in the workplace.
Students will learn to analyze and think systematically about opportunities and challenges in participating in the global agricultural market.
Students will demonstrate social responsibility and compliance with laws and regulations.
Students will develop the ability to independently study and accumulate knowledge and experience to continue higher education and adapt to changing work environments.
